name: KineticText
description: Text whose letters move one after another in a loop: a wave, a bounce or a pulse. Plain CSS, staggered by letter position.

children.description: The text. Words never split across lines mid-word.

duration.description: Seconds for one loop of a single letter.

stagger.description: Seconds between one letter starting and the next.

isPaused.description: Stops the animation and shows the finished text. Moving content that lasts more than five seconds should be stoppable.

requirements: The full text is in a visually hidden copy; the animated letters are hidden from assistive technology
Letters move by a fraction of a line height and never leave their slot, so the text stays readable and does not reflow
Decoration only: the animated layers are hidden from assistive technology and never take focus
Stands still for visitors who ask for less motion (prefers-reduced-motion), and can also be shown still with the rdm-still class or isPaused
In forced-colors (high contrast) mode the text is drawn in the system colours with no effect
Does not flash: nothing changes more than three times in a second (WCAG 2.3.1)
The text is real text in the server HTML, readable with no script
Optional: it is a separate component, so projects that do not add it carry none of its code

use_when: A short playful heading or a loading message
A single word that should draw the eye
avoid_when: Paragraphs and any text people have to read closely
Content that must stay still for people who are easily distracted: always offer isPaused
anti_patterns: Looping a long sentence, which makes it tiring to read
